All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Downloader
The `Downloader` class implements the `Runnable` interface and represents a downloader responsible for sending multicast messages and listening for NACK (Not Acknowledged) and termination messages.
Gateway
The Gateway class serves as a central coordinator in a distributed indexing system.
GatewayInterface
Remote interface for the Gateway server in a distributed system.
IndexStorageBarrel
The `IndexStorageBarrel` class represents a storage barrel for indexing web pages.
IndexStorageBarrelInterface
The IndexStorageBarrelInterface interface represents the remote interface for an index storage barrel.
MessageChunk
Represents a chunk of a message, used for breaking down large messages into smaller parts.
NACKMessage
Represents a Negative Acknowledgement (NACK) message.
PageInfo
Represents information about a web page.
RMIClient
The RMIClient class represents a client program that connects to the RMI Registry and interacts with the system.
TerminationMessage
The TerminationMessage class represents a message indicating the termination of a thread.
URLTask
Represents a URL task with a priority.
